title: The Naked Glass
scene: You are on the welded bench in Encore, still downtown, engine dead. Yuna's wheel is empty. The windshield is just glass — no mesh, no bars, the whole street in your face. The bench under you came out of another car. Dead in-ears hang on the cage tube, one earpiece in the loop, one dangling. She chose to see the block and let the block see her. The Menace is a street over. You have not walked to it yet.
debrief: Encore has no mesh. Intact glass, a bench welded in for people, dead in-ears on the cage. The mesh is back on the next street.

source.teaching_target: Establish Encore's cab: no mesh, intact glass, passenger bench, dead in-ears; she chose visibility over armor.

image_brief.camera_pose: Camera is inside Encore on the welded-in rear bench, looking forward through the cabin at the windshield. The bench and cage tubing occupy the bottom of frame. The empty suede racing wheel sits ahead. Intact windshield glass, clean and unbroken, no mesh.
image_brief.subject: intact windshield glass with no mesh — a wide open view of the wet downtown street
image_brief.foreground: mismatched welded rear bench from another car, cage tubing, dead wireless in-ears hanging on the tube with one earpiece dangling
image_brief.midground: empty suede racing wheel, stripped metal dash, a guarded red PA switch left off
image_brief.background: overcast downtown Seattle through naked glass, wet pavement, no readable signs
image_brief.read: the windshield is intact glass with no mesh; this cab has a bench for people and nothing between them and the road
extra_negatives: no bar cage over the glass
no PA horns inside the cabin
